pages.text: The $(d)Ender Letter$() allows you to send items to other players more easily. It can store up to 9 stacks inside itself.$(br2)In its GUI, type the recipient's username. Then, simply use it on any $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/ender_mailbox)Ender Mailbox$(/l). If the recipient's Mailbox is not full, it will be placed inside it.
